title: Set Up Business Central Data Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric

facts.text: Connect to Microsoft Fabric is preview; version 29.1 or later required
Business Central online environment must have version 29.1 or later
Business Central Mirroring to Fabric extension must be installed from Microsoft Marketplace
User account requires MS Fabric Mirroring - Admin permission set or equivalent
Fabric workspace must be in same Microsoft Entra tenant as Business Central environment
Fabric workspace must be assigned to active Microsoft Fabric capacity; paused or deleted capacity stops replication
Service principal created for Dynamics 365 Business Central Fabric Export application handles authentication with Fabric
Create open mirrored database in Microsoft Fabric to receive Business Central data
